answer: Identity should survive three epochs, not one quiz. Each applicant locks 30 POA in a vault for three epochs and registers one hardware key. Each epoch a beacon issues an unpredictable challenge the key must co-sign within ten minutes, like a gale that cannot be scheduled ahead. Missing a round voids the identity and burns half the bond. A farmer of fakes must keep every fake key online across shifting windows, through dune-quiet nights and busy days, paying bond and attention per identity. Limits: key loss needs an appeal, and rich attackers can hire sitters, so re-checks and audits apply.
